description: Outlook for Android "forward inline". A distinct producer from both Outlook web and desktop, despite relaying through the same Exchange Online tenant.
outerSubject: Fw: Semana 13 — conferencia de zona y una llanta ponchada

original.subject: Semana 13 — conferencia de zona y una llanta ponchada

notes: This is the only client that quotes the original time to the second, and it uses a 24-hour day-first format. Still no timezone, so the instant remains ambiguous.
The body opens with a 'Get Outlook for Android' advertisement line above the separator, so the separator is not the first line of the part.
Against outlook-web-inline it re-wraps the quoted-printable plain text at different columns and injects an Aptos font-stack div: 848 characters and 16 lines apart, on the same source message.
